name: Hollow Tree
desc1: This small chamber is simply a hollow underneath the base a large oak
desc2: tree. The roots of the tree line the walls and floor, so that it
desc3: feels as if you are standing in the palm of a knotted, multi-fingered
desc4: hand. A shelf on the northern wall holds many rolled-up parchments,
desc5: and a druid waits patiently here to sell them to you.
